info.name: Vacation Resorts - Complete API
info.description:
Vacation Resorts API collection matched to the main branch on 8 October 2026.

QUICK START
1. Start MySQL and the backend. baseUrl includes /api, without a trailing slash.
2. Run Register new test user; the returned JWT is automatically saved in userToken.
3. Set adminEmail/adminPassword locally and run Sign in admin; adminToken is saved automatically. No real secrets are included in this export.
4. Run Get all vacations to select an existing vacation and image.
5. For admin CRUD, select a local image in each file request. Do not manually set multipart Content-Type: Postman creates the boundary.

SIDE EFFECTS
Registration creates a disposable user; Like/Unlike change that user's likes; admin CRUD creates/updates/deletes a disposable vacation. Delete uses a separate createdVacationId. Use a development database. AI/MCP question requests use paid OpenAI calls. Raw MCP calls do not.

RUNNER
Use a delay of 1000 ms to avoid the backend rate limiter, and allow 150000 ms request timeout for AI. Folder 04 requires manual file setup and intentional deletion; select only desired folders rather than blindly running the whole collection. Preserve selected local file access if using the desktop Runner. Dates for creation are generated at send time.

EXPECTED RESPONSES
201 registration/create/like, 200 reads/sign-in/update/AI/MCP, 204 unlike/delete; 401 unauthenticated, 403 wrong role, 404 missing route/vacation, 409 duplicate email, 422 invalid input. Assertions expose errors; they do not hide unexpected responses.

LIMITS
No /health or backend CSV route exists in the current source. Test CSV download in the frontend. The collection is structurally checked, not proof that live database/OpenAI checks passed. Password minimums in the backend currently differ from the assignment's four-character rule; review separately before submission. Tokens and passwords saved locally in Postman must not be included in a future exported submission.
